text:
devex: Heads-up: We’re retiring legacy CI service-account PATs on 2025-05-15. This affects any pipeline using long-lived tokens (GHA secrets, self-hosted runner creds). Please migrate to OIDC role-binding or short-lived runner creds by then. See the migration playbook linked below.

maria: ack — can you paste the minimal example for the OIDC role trust?

devex: sure — minimal AWS trust policy we recommend:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/token.actions.githubusercontent.com"
      },
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "token.actions.githubusercontent.com:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}```

kevin: do we have an inventory of repos still using PATs? I can run a scan but want to avoid false positives.

devex: we ran a seed scan last week; ~120 repos flagged. We’ll post the full list (org+repo) tomorrow. If you want to pre-check: run `gh secret list --repo org/repo` and look for keys named like `CI_TOKEN` or `SELF_HOSTED_SSH_KEY`.

sam: any change to how our reusable workflows authenticate? We use a couple of central workflow templates in .github/actions/ci-templates.

devex: no code change required for most reusable workflows — we added a tiny helper action `redwood/oidc-assume@v1` that wraps `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials` and sets role via OIDC. Replace the step that used the PAT with:```yaml
- uses: redwood/oidc-assume@v1
  with:
    role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-role
```

helena: what about services that still need long-lived creds (external vendors, legacy deploy scripts)?

security-bot: Security note: long-lived creds will be blocked from accessing production after 2025-05-15. We can whitelist exceptions via security tickets but expect extra review and quarterly rotation requirements.

kevin: can we get an ETA for the full rollout (scanning + outreach + enforcement)?

devex: plan: 1) week 0-1: final inventory + automated PRs for top-20 repos (we’ll open PRs that swap to OIDC where possible). 2) week 2-4: migrate remaining active repos with maintainers (we’ll provide pair sessions). 3) week 5: read-only enforcement (CI triggers fail if PAT detected). 4) week 6: enforcement block. I’ll post calendar invites for migration office hours.

maria: thumbs up. Will the automated PRs touch secrets or just workflow files?

devex: only workflow files and README notes. We never touch org secrets. PRs include a checklist in the description and a small test plan to run in a fork.

sam: is there a rollback plan if a PR breaks infra?

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline: CI run logs will be preserved and you can revert the workflow PR like a normal PR. Canary deployments are encouraged on ded-ci-01 before touching prod pipelines.

kevin: any changes to RBAC or org-level permissions we need to know?

devex: yes — we’ll create a new org role binding `ci-oidc-role` and a restricted team `infra/ci-service-accounts` for role assumption. Only service owners should be in that team. We’ll send an invite flow for owners to request access.

helena: please add a short FAQ about token naming conventions and how to test locally (we get lots of questions on that).

devex: noted — FAQ + troubleshooting guide will be added to the playbook. Office hours Friday 14:00 UTC. Ping @devex if you want a private slot.

maria: thanks — will start inventorying my repos tomorrow.

kevin: thanks, team. I’ll help correlate the scan with repo activity to prioritize.

devex: thanks everyone. We’ll post the org-wide list tomorrow and start opening PRs next week. :rocket:
